archetypes.name: dyn-topology
archetypes.rationale: Topology lint behavior changed from rule frontmatter to TSV authority validation.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the topology-rule-paths lint and its harness. Focus on fixture behavior, git-root detection, symlink containment, authority value checks, and compatibility of the unchanged CLI verb. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
